label: B2
name: Scenario B2 - link n1-n2 failure, static routing
description: Identical failure to B1 (link n1-n2 down from t = 3.0 s to t = 6.0 s), but routes are computed once at start-up (rtProto Static). This shows what happens when routing does not react to the failure.
known_cause: Link n1-n2 was deliberately disabled with `$ns rtmodel-at 3.0 down $n1 $n2` and re-enabled at t = 6.0 s. Static routing is the second controlled condition.
